projects.title: Python CLI Expense Tracker
projects.blurb: A Python learning project for recording expenses in the terminal, filtering by category and calculating totals using Decimal. Saves records to CSV and validates date and amount input. See the README for storage and backup limitations.

projects.title: Civic Lens
projects.blurb: A UK politics explainer covering Parliament, general elections, devolution, the party landscape across all four nations, and the terminology that ties it together. Every data-driven page calls a FastAPI backend first and falls back to bundled static data when it is unreachable, so the same build runs full-stack locally and as a static site on Pages.

projects.title: AI Stock Assistant
projects.blurb: Warehouse inventory management with AI image recognition running entirely in the browser — photograph an item and TensorFlow.js matches it against stock, auto-detecting category and SKU prefix. Adds a metrics dashboard, location/SKU search and JWT-authenticated accounts.

projects.title: NutriTrack
projects.blurb: A calorie and exercise tracker built as a single-file vanilla JS app with no build step. Scans product barcodes through the camera with Quagga.js and looks nutrition up against the Open Food Facts API, persisting to Firestore with a debounced localStorage fallback so it keeps working offline.

projects.title: Horse Racing Prediction
projects.blurb: An XGBoost classifier trained on a decade of UK and Ireland racing data (2015–2025). Split into clean, testable stages — Kaggle dataset loading, feature engineering and cleaning, then model training and evaluation — behind a single config dataclass.

projects.title: PyFileAutomation
projects.blurb: Takes the RPA approach to a repetitive, rule-based chore: sorts a messy folder into subfolders by file type, with a dry-run mode that previews every move before touching anything, optional file logging, desktop notifications and Discord webhook summaries. Scanner, mover, notifier and logger are separate modules.

projects.title: Chore Tracker
projects.blurb: A mobile-first household chore tracker in a single HTML file — daily and weekly recurring tasks, custom groups, streak counting, and a light/dark theme toggle. No backend, no dependencies; state lives in localStorage.

projects.title: TrendTracker
projects.blurb: A Google-Trends-style dashboard for surfacing trending topics and translating raw signal into plain language. React and Vite on the front end, FastAPI serving the data layer with interactive OpenAPI docs.

projects.title: Cold Outreach Tool
projects.blurb: A lightweight bulk email sender for sales outreach: upload a CSV of contacts, personalise templates with {{field}} variables, and drip through Gmail SMTP with an adjustable delay to stay clear of spam filters.

projects.title: BioHub Cell Tracking
projects.blurb: Computer vision work for the BioHub Cell Tracking Kaggle competition, structured as a progression of notebooks — exploration, preprocessing, then a baseline model — over a reusable src package for data loading and visualisation.

projects.title: Task Manager API
projects.blurb: A task management REST API written in C# on .NET, built to practise the language and its tooling outside the usual JavaScript and Python stack.
